entries.sense_en: much more than is normal or sensible

synonyms.nuance: Just means 'very, very'; no criticism. Excessively says the amount is too much.
Also critical, but more everyday and usually before adjectives like cautious or sensitive.
Formal; 'more than is justified', often in negatives: not unduly worried.

entries.tip_ko: excessively fond of는 '좋아하는 정도가 지나치다'는 비판이 담긴 표현이에요.

entries.sense_en: a room or large cupboard where someone's clothes are kept

synonyms.nuance: American word for a small built-in room or cupboard for clothes.
A room for getting dressed, in a house or backstage at a theater.
synonyms.example: She waited in the dressing room.

synonyms.nuance: A tall, often antique, freestanding wardrobe; sounds elegant or French.

entries.tip_ko: wardrobe는 '가지고 있는 옷 전체'라는 뜻도 있어요: a summer wardrobe.

entries.sense_en: hunting animals as a sport

synonyms.nuance: The ordinary word; can be a single event or the activity.
Formal; following someone to catch them, not only animals.

entries.sense_en: a dishonest man who cheats people

synonyms.nuance: Specifically someone who tricks people out of money.
Milder, often playful; used for naughty children too.
Informal and modern; any criminal or dishonest person.

entries.sense_en: to announce or claim publicly, often something untrue

synonyms.nuance: Neutral modern word; says something is true without proof.
synonyms.example: He claimed to be a doctor.

synonyms.nuance: Official and public; no suggestion of lying.
Spreads information indirectly, without saying it to each person.
synonyms.example: She let it be known she was leaving.

entries.tip_ko: 오늘날 give out은 주로 '나눠주다' 또는 '(기계·힘이) 다하다'라는 뜻이에요.

entries.sense_en: having many small, carefully arranged parts or details

synonyms.nuance: Stresses many tiny parts that are hard to follow.
Neutral; full of details, not necessarily decorative.
Heavily decorated, sometimes too much.

entries.tip_ko: 형용사는 /ɪˈlæbərət/, 동사(자세히 설명하다)는 /ɪˈlæbəreɪt/로 끝소리가 달라요.

entries.sense_en: a special quality or power that something has

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for any feature, good or bad.
A typical feature that helps identify something.
Formal; a quality thought of as belonging to someone or something.

entries.tip_ko: property는 흔히 '재산'이지만 과학·기술 글에서는 '성질'이에요: magnetic properties.

entries.sense_en: not good enough or not suitable for a job or purpose

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; simply the wrong choice for a situation.
Stronger: lacks the skill to do the job; an insult.
Lacks the required training or certificates.

entries.tip_ko: unfit은 '몸이 건강하지 않은'이라는 뜻으로도 자주 쓰여요.

entries.sense_en: a country ruled by a king or emperor; a kingdom

synonyms.nuance: Plain word; a country with a king or queen.
Land or area under someone's control; also a field of knowledge.
Many lands or peoples under one ruler.

entries.tip_ko: realm의 ea는 /ɛ/로 짧게 발음해요: '렐름'.

entries.sense_en: to see the difference between two kinds of people or things

synonyms.nuance: Informal; usually about things that look alike.
synonyms.example: I can't tell the twins apart.

synonyms.nuance: More formal or technical; also 'make different'.
Formal; notice something with effort, by eye or by judgment.

entries.tip_ko: distinguish A from B = A와 B를 구별하다.

entries.sense_en: at once, without waiting

synonyms.nuance: The normal modern word for 'at once'.
Informal spoken equivalent.
Quickly and on time, often as a good habit.

entries.tip_ko: 지금 directly는 주로 '직접'이라는 뜻이고, '즉시'의 뜻은 영국 구어에 조금 남아 있어요.

entries.sense_en: a frame or machine for weaving thread into cloth

synonyms.nuance: Makes thread from wool or cotton; a loom then weaves the thread.
General word for any structure that holds something; the story also calls the looms 'frames'.

entries.tip_ko: 동사 loom은 '(위협적으로) 어렴풋이 나타나다'라는 전혀 다른 뜻이에요.

entries.sense_en: to pretend to be doing or feeling something

synonyms.nuance: The ordinary word; used with 'to' or a that-clause.
Formal; pretend a feeling or state, like illness or surprise.
Informal; can also mean make a false copy.

entries.modern: affected to work → pretended to work
entries.tip_ko: affect의 흔한 뜻은 '영향을 주다'예요. 여기서는 '척하다'라는 옛 뜻이에요.

entries.sense_en: a bag carried on the back

synonyms.nuance: The normal modern word, especially for school or travel.
British; usually a large one for hiking.
Carried on the shoulder with one strap, often leather.

entries.tip_ko: k는 소리 나지 않아요: /ˈnæpsæk/.

entries.sense_en: (of time) to pass

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; same meaning.
Informal, often in speech.
Usually about a contract or right ending because time ran out.

entries.tip_ko: elapse는 시간만 주어로 써요: Time elapsed (O), I elapsed (X).

entries.sense_en: a foolish person who is easily tricked

synonyms.nuance: General word for someone who acts stupidly.
Stronger and ruder in modern speech.
Informal; someone easily cheated.

entries.sense_en: news or information about something

synonyms.nuance: The everyday word for new information.
Neutral, general facts.
Old-fashioned and literary.

entries.tip_ko: 지금은 '지능' 또는 '첩보'(CIA 같은 정보기관)의 뜻으로 써요.

entries.sense_en: long and careful thought before deciding

synonyms.nuance: More general; thinking about something, not always long.
Quiet thinking, often about the past or oneself.
Discussion between people; deliberation can happen alone.

entries.sense_en: a dishonest, tricky man

synonyms.nuance: Also dishonest, but can be charming; still used today.
Stronger moral disapproval; old-fashioned.
Modern and plain; someone who breaks rules to win.

entries.tip_ko: k는 묵음이에요: /neɪv/. 카드의 잭(Jack)을 옛날엔 knave라고 했어요.

entries.sense_en: using all one's strength and effort

synonyms.nuance: Plain everyday phrasing.
synonyms.example: She pushed as hard as possible.

synonyms.nuance: Informal; at full speed or effort.
Old-fashioned, literary doubling of the same idea.
synonyms.example: they rowed with might and main

entries.tip_ko: 여기 might는 조동사가 아니라 명사 '힘'이에요.

entries.sense_en: someone who pretends to be someone they are not, to trick people

synonyms.nuance: Broader: any person or thing that is not what it claims.
Informal; also used for objects.
Informal; a skilled cheater who wins people's trust.

entries.tip_ko: impostor syndrome(가면 증후군)에서도 이 단어가 쓰여요.

entries.sense_en: in a polite and respectful way

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; basic good manners.
Shows respect for someone's rank or opinion.
Just polite enough, sometimes despite dislike.
synonyms.example: They spoke civilly to each other.

entries.tip_ko: courteous의 첫소리는 /kɜr/예요. '코트'가 아니라 '커-'.

entries.sense_en: namely; used before explaining exactly what you mean

synonyms.nuance: The plain word; spoken and written.
synonyms.example: two colors, namely red and blue

synonyms.nuance: Common, often written 'i.e.'.
Written abbreviation, very common in modern texts.
synonyms.example: on weekdays, i.e. Monday to Friday

entries.tip_ko: 라틴어 videlicet의 줄임말로, 소리 내어 읽을 땐 보통 namely라고 해요.

entries.sense_en: to admit something you feel ashamed of

synonyms.nuance: Everyday; accept that something is true, often unwillingly.
Informal; admit a mistake or wrongdoing.
synonyms.example: Nobody owned up to breaking it.

synonyms.nuance: Formal; accept a fact publicly.

entries.tip_ko: confess는 사랑 고백보다 잘못·약점을 털어놓을 때 더 자주 써요.

entries.sense_en: glasses worn to see better

synonyms.nuance: The normal modern word.
Informal, mainly British.
Close-fitting glasses for protection, e.g. swimming.

entries.tip_ko: 단수 spectacle은 '장관, 구경거리'라는 다른 뜻이에요.

entries.sense_en: very grateful to someone for their help

synonyms.nuance: Plain, sincere thanks.
Often relief that something bad didn't happen.
synonyms.example: thankful that no one was hurt

synonyms.nuance: Formal; feels one owes a return for a big help.

entries.modern: We shall be much obliged → Thank you very much

entries.sense_en: carefully, giving full attention

synonyms.nuance: General; avoiding mistakes, not only listening.
With strong focus, often by looking.
synonyms.example: She stared intently at the screen.

synonyms.nuance: Looking or following in detail.

entries.sense_en: steady, careful hard work

synonyms.nuance: Plain everyday phrase.
Formal, old-fashioned sense of 'hard work'.
Stresses not giving up over a long time.

entries.tip_ko: diligent(부지런한)의 명사형이에요. 첫 음절에 강세: DIL-i-gence.

entries.sense_en: to find out something for certain

synonyms.nuance: Everyday phrasal verb.
Formal; often by investigation or calculation.
Quick look to make sure.
synonyms.example: Check that the door is locked.

entries.tip_ko: 강세는 마지막 음절: as-cer-TAIN.

entries.sense_en: to look carefully at the whole of something

synonyms.nuance: Look closely at details to find something out.
Look quickly over an area to find something.
Officially check for problems.

entries.tip_ko: 동사는 sur-VEY, 명사(설문조사)는 SUR-vey로 강세가 달라요.

entries.sense_en: so; as a result of that

synonyms.nuance: Formal logical conclusion, common in arguments.
The everyday word.
synonyms.example: It rained, so we stayed in.

synonyms.nuance: Formal; stresses cause and effect.

entries.tip_ko: act accordingly(그에 맞게 행동하다)처럼 '상황에 맞게'라는 뜻도 있어요.

entries.sense_en: a king, queen or emperor who rules a country

synonyms.nuance: Neutral term for a king or queen.
Anyone who rules, including non-royals.
Specific male monarch; everyday word.

entries.tip_ko: g는 묵음: /ˈsɑvrən/. 형용사로는 '주권을 가진'(a sovereign state).

entries.sense_en: clever at tricking people to get what you want

synonyms.nuance: Similar; stresses clever planning, can be admired.
Secretive and sneaky; often about a look or smile.
Experienced at tricks; often about old or clever people.

entries.tip_ko: craft(공예)와 관련 있지만 crafty는 거의 항상 '교활한'이라는 뜻이에요.

entries.sense_en: extremely beautiful and delicately made

synonyms.nuance: General; no idea of fine, delicate work.
Fine and easily damaged.
Excellent quality, often about performance or food.

entries.tip_ko: 강세는 EX-qui-site와 ex-QUI-site 둘 다 쓰여요.

entries.sense_en: approval or praise

synonyms.nuance: The everyday word.
Spoken words saying something is good.
Public, official support.

entries.sense_en: in a kind, polite way, as an important person might

synonyms.nuance: Plain kindness; no idea of high rank.
Politeness and good manners.
About smooth, elegant movement or accepting defeat well.

entries.tip_ko: graciously(태도가 너그럽게)와 gracefully(움직임이 우아하게)를 헷갈리기 쉬워요.

entries.sense_en: the group of servants and officials who travel with an important person

synonyms.nuance: Modern word, e.g. for a celebrity's team.
People who serve or help someone.
People who go with someone for protection.

entries.sense_en: to try very hard to see something

synonyms.nuance: Partly close the eyes to see better.
Look carefully because something is hard to see.
Look for a long time, not necessarily with effort.

entries.tip_ko: strain one's ears는 '귀를 기울이다'예요.

entries.sense_en: happy and full of fun

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for a happy mood.
Old-fashioned; now mostly in 'Merry Christmas'.
Friendly and loud in a happy way.

entries.tip_ko: 옛 문학에서 gay는 '명랑한'이라는 뜻이에요. 현대 영어에서는 이 뜻으로 쓰지 않아요.

entries.sense_en: a ribbon, here one given as a sign of honor

synonyms.nuance: The modern spelling and word.
A metal disc given as an award.
A wide band worn over the shoulder or waist.

entries.sense_en: a line of people moving slowly through the streets as part of a ceremony

synonyms.nuance: Festive, often with music and floats.
Organized walk, often soldiers or protesters.
Formal; a slow procession, especially at a funeral.

entries.sense_en: to stay awake late instead of going to bed

synonyms.nuance: The more common modern phrase.
Informal; stay awake all night to work or study.
synonyms.example: I pulled an all-nighter before the exam.

entries.tip_ko: sit up은 '(누웠다가) 일어나 앉다'라는 뜻도 있어요.

entries.sense_en: wanting very much to do something

synonyms.nuance: Keen and excited, with no worry.
British-leaning; interested and willing.
The other meaning of anxious: afraid something bad will happen.

entries.tip_ko: anxious to + 동사 = '~하고 싶어 안달하는', anxious about = '~을 걱정하는'.

entries.sense_en: a person of high rank or importance

synonyms.nuance: Someone born into a high social class.
Modern; an important official person.
Informal and slightly mocking.

entries.sense_en: a long loose cloak without sleeves

synonyms.nuance: Common word for the same garment.
Usually shorter, like a superhero's.
Long garment worn for ceremonies or at home.

entries.tip_ko: take up the mantle은 '(책임·역할을) 이어받다'라는 비유 표현이에요.

entries.sense_en: a spider's web, often an old dusty one

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; any web, including neat new ones.
Literary; very fine, light threads or fabric.

entries.sense_en: to imagine or believe something

synonyms.nuance: Everyday; picture something in the mind.
Think something is probably true.
Have a sense or impression.
synonyms.example: It feels like nothing is there.

entries.modern: one might fancy → you might think
entries.tip_ko: 영국 구어 fancy는 '~을 원하다, 좋아하다'예요: Fancy a coffee?

entries.sense_en: a person who works for or keeps company with a king at court

synonyms.nuance: Anyone who serves another; less about royal life.
Stresses praising someone to win favor.
About rank by birth, not service at court.

entries.sense_en: to dress someone in fine clothes

synonyms.nuance: The plain word.
Formal; provide or put on clothes.
Informal; decorate or dress very colorfully.

entries.modern: array him in → dress him in
entries.tip_ko: 명사 array는 '죽 늘어선 것, 다양한 것'이에요: a wide array of options.

entries.sense_en: a cloth held up on poles above an important person

synonyms.nuance: Fixed cloth cover over a shop window or door.
General word for anything that blocks sunlight.
A shelter you can sleep in, closed on the sides.

entries.tip_ko: 숲의 '수관층'(나무 윗부분이 덮은 층)도 canopy라고 해요.

entries.sense_en: carried

synonyms.nuance: The everyday word.
Formal; transport, or communicate an idea.
Keep something raised.

entries.modern: to be borne → to be carried
entries.tip_ko: bear-bore-borne. born(태어난)과 철자를 헷갈리지 마세요.

entries.sense_en: a bedroom, here the king's private rooms

synonyms.nuance: The normal modern word.
Old or formal word for a room.

entries.modern: lords of the bedchamber → the king's personal attendants

entries.sense_en: the long back part of a robe or dress that trails on the ground

synonyms.nuance: The folded bottom edge of any clothing.
Thin cloth over a bride's face or head, not a trailing skirt.

entries.tip_ko: 웨딩드레스 뒤로 길게 끌리는 부분도 train이에요.

entries.sense_en: to show something by accident that you want to hide

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; show or tell, on purpose or not.
Informal; accidentally let something be known.
Plain word, no idea of hiding.

entries.tip_ko: betray는 '배신하다'가 흔한 뜻이지만 '감정·약점을 드러내다'도 자주 써요.

entries.sense_en: not at all; in no way

synonyms.nuance: Everyday and softer.
Very strong; often a rule or order.
synonyms.example: Under no circumstances open this door.

synonyms.nuance: Formal, similar strength.
synonyms.example: This is in no way your fault.

entries.tip_ko: by all means는 반대로 '물론이죠, 얼마든지'예요.

entries.sense_en: to admit that something is true

synonyms.nuance: The common modern word here.
synonyms.example: He admitted he couldn't see it.

synonyms.nuance: Formal; admit after first denying or arguing.
Accept a point in an argument.

entries.tip_ko: allow의 흔한 뜻은 '허락하다'예요. 발음은 /əˈlaʊ/ '얼라우'.

entries.sense_en: the honest, simple quality of a child who does not lie or pretend

synonyms.nuance: Negative: too trusting, lacking experience.
Moral cleanness; often religious tone.
Honesty in speech, saying what one thinks.

entries.tip_ko: innocence는 법률 용어로 '무죄'이기도 해요.

entries.sense_en: annoyed and upset

synonyms.nuance: The everyday word; mild anger.
Annoyed by something repeated or small.
Deeply embarrassed, which fits his public shame.

entries.tip_ko: a vexed question은 '논란이 많은 문제'라는 뜻이에요.

entries.sense_en: to make a great effort to do something well

synonyms.nuance: Everyday and neutral.
synonyms.example: Make an effort to be on time.

synonyms.nuance: Do more than needed, often to help someone.
synonyms.example: She went out of her way to help.

synonyms.nuance: Informal; try extremely hard, often to please.
synonyms.example: They bent over backwards for us.

entries.tip_ko: pains는 '고통'이 아니라 '수고'예요. take pains to + 동사.
